# examples/figures/

This folder holds reference figures and output plots from the example notebooks.

**How to use:**

- Place any pre-made reference figures (PNG, PDF) here so the notebooks can
  display them with `IPython.display.Image("figures/your_figure.png")`.
- The notebooks automatically save their generated plots here too.

**Git note:** Output plots generated by running the notebooks are listed in
`.gitignore` (they are large binary files and can be reproduced).  Only
hand-curated reference figures should be committed.
